from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from downloads import resolve_download

with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='download-check-', dir='.') as tmp:
    base = Path(tmp).resolve()
    root = base / 'root'
    root.mkdir()
    (root / 'nested').mkdir()
    (root / 'nested' / 'file.txt').write_bytes(b'unchanged')
    sibling = base / 'root-other'
    sibling.mkdir()
    (sibling / 'secret.txt').write_bytes(b'outside')
    (root / 'inside').symlink_to(root / 'nested', target_is_directory=True)
    (root / 'outside').symlink_to(sibling, target_is_directory=True)

    def snapshot():
        result = {}
        for p in base.rglob('*'):
            stat = p.lstat()
            kind = ('link', str(p.readlink())) if p.is_symlink() else ('dir', None) if p.is_dir() else ('file', p.read_bytes())
            result[str(p.relative_to(base))] = (kind, stat.st_mode, stat.st_size, stat.st_mtime_ns, stat.st_ctime_ns)
        return result

    before = snapshot()
    accepted = {
        'nested/file.txt': root / 'nested/file.txt',
        'nested/../nested/file.txt': root / 'nested/file.txt',
        'inside/file.txt': root / 'nested/file.txt',
        'missing/child.txt': root / 'missing/child.txt',
        '.': root,
        '': root,
    }
    for name, expected in accepted.items():
        actual = resolve_download(root, name)
        assert isinstance(actual, Path)
        assert actual == expected, (name, actual)
    rejected = [str(root / 'nested/file.txt'), str(sibling / 'secret.txt'), '../root-other/secret.txt', '../elsewhere', 'outside/secret.txt', 'outside/missing.txt', '../../escape']
    for name in rejected:
        try:
            resolve_download(root, name)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f'Accepted forbidden name: {name}')
    assert resolve_download(root.relative_to(Path.cwd()), 'inside/file.txt') == root / 'nested/file.txt'
    assert snapshot() == before, 'Resolution changed filesystem contents or metadata'
    print('Passed: 6 accepted names, 7 rejected names, relative root, and filesystem preservation.')
